## Category 1: GravatarAvatar Component (4 tests)

### UAT-1.1: isPledger prop adds blue ring
**Given:** GravatarAvatar rendered with `isPledger={true}`
**Then:** Avatar has blue ring (ring-2 or ring-3 class with ring-blue-500)
**Verify:** Unit test assertion on className

### UAT-1.2: isPledger=false has no ring
**Given:** GravatarAvatar rendered with `isPledger={false}` or prop omitted
**Then:** Avatar has no ring classes
**Verify:** Unit test assertion — no ring-blue-500 class

### UAT-1.3: showPledgeBadge renders checkmark
**Given:** GravatarAvatar rendered with `showPledgeBadge={true}`
**Then:** Small checkmark badge appears at bottom-right
**Verify:** Unit test — badge element exists with correct classes

### UAT-1.4: All sizes render ring correctly
**Given:** GravatarAvatar rendered at sm, md, lg sizes with `isPledger={true}`
**Then:** Ring is visible and proportional at all sizes
**Verify:** Unit test for each size variant

---

## Category 2: Navigation Integration (2 tests)

### UAT-2.1: Logged-in pledger sees ring on nav avatar
**Given:** User is logged in AND has pledged
**When:** Navigation renders
**Then:** Avatar in nav bar shows blue ring
**Verify:** Playwright MCP screenshot of nav with logged-in pledger

### UAT-2.2: Logged-in non-pledger has no ring
**Given:** User is logged in AND has NOT pledged
**When:** Navigation renders
**Then:** Avatar in nav bar has NO blue ring
**Verify:** Unit test or Playwright MCP

---

## Category 3: PledgerCard Integration (2 tests)

### UAT-3.1: Pledger cards show ring
**Given:** PledgerCard component renders
**Then:** Avatar shows blue ring (all cards are pledgers by definition)
**Verify:** Playwright MCP screenshot of /pledgers page

### UAT-3.2: Landing page signature wall shows rings
**Given:** User views landing page signature wall section
**Then:** All pledger avatars show blue ring
**Verify:** Playwright MCP screenshot of landing page #signatures section

---

## Category 4: CompactProfileCard Refactor (2 tests)

### UAT-4.1: CompactProfileCard uses GravatarAvatar
**Given:** CompactProfileCard component code
**Then:** Uses `<GravatarAvatar>` component (not inline avatar markup)
**Verify:** Code inspection — import and usage of GravatarAvatar

### UAT-4.2: Profile page still shows ring for pledgers
**Given:** User views a pledger's profile page
**Then:** Avatar shows blue ring (behavior unchanged from P75)
**Verify:** Playwright MCP screenshot of profile page
